sources.title: Beccaria and Ternes: damping with first JUNO data
not_verified: authors numerical likelihood or code release
sources.download_status: HTML only in this unit; F7.2 earlier custody is not re-certified here.
sources.inference: Matching exponent n=-2 alone is insufficient. A double commutator with H generally has rates proportional to squared mass-squared splittings, not this equality/zero texture.

sources.title: Wright et al.: Ia deflagration-to-detonation neutrino prediction
available: model N100nu time,energy,flavor,trajectory predictions in article
JUNO-like interaction expectation at10kpc:0.014 NMO,0.032 IMO before efficiency loss
sources.download_status: Article only; no simulation flux file downloaded.
sources.inference: The model already takes vacuum propagation to Earth as decohered. Additional pure dephasing in the same mass basis after complete decoherence cannot alter the populations; effects in matter/production require a separate calculation.
